name: Goal24 Checkpoint 8 Lane A - Brain Outcome Core + Trusted Verification Evaluation + Outcome Persistence
base_note: origin/dev/goal24-cli-skills, verified exact after git fetch --all --tags --prune
commit_sha_note: code/test tip at the time this manifest was written; the manifest itself is committed as the branch tip immediately after

commits.message: feat(outcome): add outcome and verification contracts
feat(outcome): add trusted deterministic evaluator runtime
feat(outcome): persist verification lifecycle and history
test(outcome): separate process success from verified outcome

execution_vs_outcome.write_success_rule: side_effect_class != read_only stays pending until verification_status=verified (read-back + trusted evaluator)
execution_vs_outcome.ambiguous_execution_rule: timed_out / cancelled / process_failed after spawn / unknown_after_crash default to pending and require read-back
execution_vs_outcome.not_started_rule: trusted native receipt proving no spawn -> not_required (no external effect)

verification_status_semantics.not_required: read-only action or trusted policy says no post-state verification
verification_status_semantics.pending: execution occurred / may have occurred and verification尚未完成
verification_status_semantics.verified: trusted read-back observation satisfies expected postcondition
verification_status_semantics.mismatch: read-back succeeded but external state does not match expectation
verification_status_semantics.inconclusive: observation exists but cannot establish truth sufficiently

evaluator_boundary.expectation_derived_from: approved ExecutionPlan (capability + approved normalized_inputs + verification_plan) via trusted OutcomeEvaluatorV1.deriveExpectation
evaluator_boundary.verification_failed_decided_by: parser / read-back runtime before the evaluator

caller_authority_boundary.receipt_resolution: injected TrustedReceiptResolver by receipt_id only; receipt source must be native_broker; receipt_digest recomputed and matched

binding_checks: verification_capability_id == plan verification capability and trusted evaluator metadata (OUTCOME_VERIFICATION_CAPABILITY_MISMATCH)

retry_policy.eventual_consistency: pending -> mismatch attempt -> pending retry -> verified (bounded)

rollback.candidate_condition: verification_status=mismatch AND plan.rollback_plan exists AND risk_snapshot.reversible=true

outcome_store.write_strategy: temp file + fsync + atomic rename + serialized mutation queue
outcome_store.restart_persistence: statuses and attempt history survive restart; in-flight plan/expectation context is memory-only (fail closed, documented)

tests.lint: PASS (0 errors; only pre-existing warnings outside src/outcome)

cp6_cp7_regression.note: verification_plan / rollback_plan wire contract untouched; CP7 semantics unchanged

known_residual_risks: The plan snapshot + derived expectation used during verification live in service memory: Brain restart invalidates in-flight verification (fail closed, documented); the native replay ledger is Lane B's responsibility
Trusted receipt / observation resolvers are injected Lane A abstractions; integration with the native Broker / read-back bridge is Lane B
Synthetic test capability test.item.update exists only in test fixtures; no production write capability was added
read_only outcomes default to not_required in V1; a trusted evaluator policy requiring read-back for reads is a future checkpoint decision

environment.policy: D: first, then existing C:; new installs only under D:\environment
